en: Using a ramp to load heavy boxes reduces the required pushing force, preventing dangerous back strain injuries.
Wearing rubber-soled shoes increases friction on wet floors, preventing dangerous slips and falls during the rainy season.
Wearing a helmet protects your skull from the heavy impact of gravity pulling your body down during a bicycle crash.
Never swallow small magnetic beads because they can attract each other inside your intestines and cause severe, life-threatening blockages.
Never touch electrical switches with wet hands because water conducts electricity and can cause a dangerous, potentially fatal shock.
Wearing sunglasses with UV protection blocks harmful ultraviolet light from damaging the sensitive cells inside your eyes.
Wearing foam earplugs at loud concerts reduces sound energy entering your ears, preventing permanent hearing damage.
Using a thick, dry pot holder when lifting a hot pan prevents heat from conducting into your skin and causing burns.
Wearing a seatbelt applies a stopping force to your body's forward kinetic energy during a crash, preventing severe impact injuries.
Brushing your teeth creates friction that physically scrubs away plaque bacteria, preventing painful cavities and gum disease.
Unplugging appliances by pulling the hard plastic plug prevents the internal wires from fraying and causing electrical fires.
Using a wheelbarrow acts as a second-class lever, allowing you to move heavy soil with less muscle strain.
